_doc.entry_off: soff - (frsize + frregs). IDA lays a frame out as locals [0, frsize), saved registers [frsize, frsize+frregs), the return address at frsize+frregs, then arguments; ESP at function entry points at the return address, so entry_off = soff minus that offset.
_doc.default_name: the name matches (var|arg)_s?HEX, the form IDA generates; it does not say nobody renamed a member to such a name
_doc.type_user_set: null for every member: the frame struct carries no such flag
_doc.source: ida/ida_frames.py over the FUNCTION lines of tree/src/*.cpp
